name: Pausing and resuming a folder pair

steps.text: The folder pair card named 'Music' shows the status 'Paused' and a 'Resume' button
Click the 'Resume' button in the 'Music' card
The 'Music' card no longer shows 'Paused' and its button now reads 'Pause'
Click the 'Pause' button in the 'Desktop test' card
The 'Desktop test' card shows the status 'Paused' and a 'Resume' button
